# IR-EMPOWER 2026 — Workshop on Infrared Emissivity Measurements

**Dates:** 28–29 September 2026
**Location:** Center for Applied Energy Research (CAE), Magdalene-Schoch-Straße 3, Würzburg, Germany
**Official site & registration:** <https://cae-zerocarbon.de/IR-Empower-Workshop.html>

A place to discuss infrared emissivity measurement in depth: measurement
techniques and protocols, intercomparisons and databases, modelling and
simulations, and thermophysical metrology and applications.

**Programme:** 21 talks over two days (plenaries by EHU and LTeN-CNRS),
a laboratory tour, two poster sessions, a round table and the Young Speaker
Award; about 40 participants.
[**Full programme, committee and speakers →**](/ir-empower/2026/index.html)

Second edition of the series founded in 2024, first organized by the
Thermomat / HAIRL group at EHU in Bilbao.
:::
